remarks: 2-storey townhouse in the family-friendly community of Bisset, offering 1537 sq ft, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a double attached garage & a bright, functional layout featuring new windows (2026) and a skylight. The main floor includes a kitchen with all appliances, dining area, living room with fireplace, laundry, and 2-pc half bath, plus a fenced patio and backyard. Upstairs has a primary bedroom with walk-in closet and 3-pc ensuite along with two more bedrooms, a 4-pc bath and the basement is partially finished. Located in a well-managed complex, just a 5-min walk to Bisset School & Bisset Park, near public transit, playgrounds, walking trails, restaurants, grocery stores, with quick access to Whitemud Dr & Anthony Henday Dr. (id:67522)
